latestVersion.changelog:
AI Text Video Generator — Initial Release

- Convert text (TXT, DOCX, PDF, or pasted) into ready-to-share videos with visuals and AI voiceover, no manual editing required.
- Simple onboarding: auto-detects token presence and fetches a free anonymous token if needed.
- Supports direct file uploads up to 500MB and a variety of popular video, audio, and image formats.
- Clear user workflows: edit, preview, and export 1080p MP4s in 1–2 minutes per project.
- Automatic session handling and error recovery for seamless video creation.
- Interactive prompt routing helps with exports, credits, timeline edits, and status queries.
